note: Gallery-only data. The copy (meter, deltas, warning, link names) is read from src/i18n/messages/en.json `game.chem*` by build.py. Players are real Premier League player-seasons chosen so the real link rule (chemistry.ts linkTier) produces every tier.

designs.name: Ember Rise
designs.idea: The quiet baseline: each new link's glow fades up from nothing, flares once, and settles to a low ember. Idle: two slow breaths, then still.

designs.name: Neon Trace
designs.idea: Links are DRAWN outward from the man you just placed, like neon tubing lighting from one end, with a bright flash where each one lands.

designs.name: Spark Run
designs.idea: A spark runs along every new link from the placed player to his neighbour, then the line glows in its tier colour behind it.

designs.name: Ripple Out
designs.idea: A ring ripples out from the placed disc; links light in order of distance as the ripple reaches them.

designs.name: Heartbeat
designs.idea: New links thump twice like a heartbeat (thicken and glow), and the meter thumps with them — teammates beat strongest.

designs.name: Constellation
designs.idea: A tiny star-burst at the placed disc; at rest the linked lines twinkle out of step, like a constellation coming out, then hold.

designs.name: Scanner Sweep
designs.idea: A soft vertical light bar sweeps the pitch left to right whenever the score changes; each line lights as the bar passes it.

designs.name: Domino Chain
designs.idea: Links light one after another in a quick chain, each with a small pop — the side clicking together.

designs.name: Stadium Flash
designs.idea: A brief floodlight flash over the pitch on each placement, then the new links glow and the meter pops.

designs.name: Soft Bloom
designs.idea: The most restrained option: no movement at all, just a slow bloom of glow on new links. Only teammates keep a faint glow at rest.

designs.name: Pulse Wave
designs.idea: A bright pulse travels the length of each new link twice, like current flowing between the two men.

designs.name: Tier Steps
designs.idea: Intensity IS the tier: a countryman link pulses once, a club link twice, a teammate link three times.

designs.name: Magnet Snap
designs.idea: The placed man snaps into his spot with a little overshoot, and his links snap taut from slack with an elastic finish.

designs.name: Electric Arc
designs.idea: New links flicker on like an electric arc striking, then burn steady — the mismatch's link stays dead grey.

designs.name: Halo Rings
designs.idea: The lines glow steadily; the NEIGHBOURS he links to get a ring that pulses in the tier colour, so you see who he connects with.

designs.name: Gold Thread
designs.idea: Each link is stitched from both ends at once and meets in the middle with a small flash.

designs.name: Breathing Field
designs.idea: On placement a gentle fade; at rest every linked line breathes in unison three times, strongest on teammates, then settles.

designs.name: Shockwave Warning
designs.idea: Built around the mismatch: the out-of-position man sends a red shockwave, the score shakes, and the warning shakes in.

designs.name: Ticker Count
designs.idea: Built around the score: the number slides in like a ticker, a sheen runs across the bar, and a +N / −N bubble floats off it.

designs.name: Spotlight
designs.idea: The pitch dims for a beat and a spotlight lands on the man you placed while his links glow, then the lights come back up.
